description: This file contains unit tests for the GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzer, which enforces rules about property usage in various Orleans grain-related interfaces. The tests verify that properties are disallowed in grain interfaces, addressable interfaces, and grain observers, but allow static properties. It uses the xUnit testing framework and is part of the Analyzers.Tests namespace.

classes.name: GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: A test class for the GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzer, verifying correct enforcement of property constraints across different Orleans-related interfaces.

methods.name: GrainInterfacePropertyNoError
methods.description: Verifies that interfaces with only methods pass without diagnostics.

methods.name: NoPropertiesAllowedInGrainInterface
methods.description: Checks that properties in IGrain interfaces are flagged as errors.

methods.name: NoPropertiesAllowedInIAddressableInterface
methods.description: Checks that properties in IAddressable interfaces are flagged as errors.

methods.name: NoPropertiesAllowedInIGrainObserverInterface
methods.description: Checks that properties in IGrainObserver interfaces are flagged as errors.

methods.name: StaticInterfacePropertiesAllowedInGrainInterface
methods.description: Verifies that static properties are permitted in grain interfaces.

methods.name: StaticInterfacePropertiesAllowedInAddressableInterface
methods.description: Verifies that static properties are permitted in addressable interfaces.
